text:
sam (Partnerships): Quick triage — we're starting AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace onboarding for the new Dedicated offering. Found two immediate blockers: publisher IAM roles and localized EULA. Who can take which?
jess (Legal): I can own the EULA localization + data-flow appendix. Need final product description and sample configs from Product. :+1:
omar (Product): Draft packaging blurb (feel free to reuse):
```
Redwood Dedicated — GPU-backed inference with VPC/private control plane. Includes reserved capacity billing, per-route SLAs, and optional on-prem connector.
Supported images: AMI (aws), GCP image, Azure VM image.
```
cc @maria for image/region requirements.
maria (CloudOps): For AMI we need signed AMI IDs per region, test account numbers, and a reproducible build script. Will spin up a doc: https://go.redwood/internal/marketplace/ami-onboarding (staging link). Also: Azure asks for publisher offer ID + test subscription IDs.
sam (Partnerships): Who can create the publisher IAM roles in AWS publisher portal? Kevin? We need least-privilege policy and role ARN to embed in the listing metadata.
kevin (Engineering): I can set up the AWS roles tomorrow AM. Need the minimal policy you want enforced. Jess — any legal restrictions on role capabilities/naming conventions?
jess (Legal): No naming constraints, but policy must explicitly prohibit cross-account data exports and must log key actions to our KMS/audit. I'll draft a minimal policy snippet and attach to the doc.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: staging listing must pass IAM + billing integration tests within 7 days of role/AMI upload.
sam (Partnerships): Plan: Kevin = IAM roles, Omar = final packaging copy, Maria = AMI/image + region map, Jess = EULA + minimal IAM policy. I'll create a calendar handoff and tag owners in the onboarding checklist. :thumbsup:
maria (CloudOps): One more — GCP images require a public image family + IAM for image access; Azure needs a Publisher Offer ID and test subscriptions. I'll DM procurement for test subs.
kevin (Engineering): Will post the role ARNs in the doc and run a smoke test once permissions are up.
sam (Partnerships): Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker please ping #partnerships and add "marketplace-blocker" tag in the checklist.
